annotations.title: Read a varg how to page

description: Read one varg how to card in full as Markdown: a how-to tutorial (best skills with install commands, the options to show the person with example videos, the steps, how it runs on varg) or a skill, component or video type page. Pass the kind and slug from search_how_to.

kind.description: The card's kind, exactly as search_how_to returned it (usually how_to).

slug.description: The card's slug, exactly as search_how_to returned it, e.g. make-a-lyric-video.
